Which TWO design choices BEST meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Terminate the VPNs on an AWS Transit Gateway and enable Equal-Cost Multi-Path (ECMP) routing.
answers.B: Use a Virtual Private Gateway because it automatically load-balances all tunnels from all customer gateways equally.
answers.C: Establish multiple AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections from separate customer gateway devices or appliances.
answers.D: Use a single AWS Client VPN endpoint because client sessions can aggregate throughput for data center traffic.
answers.E: Order a 1 Gbps hosted AWS Direct Connect connection as the only path and expect it to be provisioned immediately.

explanation: When internet-based connectivity must exceed the practical throughput of a single tunnel, the AWS pattern is to use multiple Site-to-Site VPN connections from separate customer gateways and terminate them on a Transit Gateway. Transit Gateway supports ECMP so traffic can be load-shared across equal-cost BGP paths. Client VPN is for individual remote users, a single hosted Direct Connect does not meet the immediate timeline or bandwidth target by itself, and Virtual Private Gateway is not the preferred design for ECMP-based aggregation across multiple connections in this scenario.
tags: Selecting the appropriate bandwidth allocation for a network device (for example, a single VPN compared with multiple VPNs, Direct Connect speed)

stem: A cloud operations team is deciding which AWS interface or resource-sharing mechanism best fits each operational requirement. Match each requirement to the MOST appropriate choice. Each answer is used once.

answers.A: AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM)
answers.B: AWS Management Console
answers.C: AWS CLI
answers.D: AWS CloudFormation

subquestions.prompt: A network team must centrally own a Transit Gateway and share it with dozens of application accounts without duplicating the resource or transferring ownership.

An incident commander needs immediate interactive access to inspect and manually change a misconfigured Route 53 health check and an ALB listener rule in a single account, with visual context and no automation artifact.
A release pipeline running in CodeBuild must invoke repeatable, scriptable AWS operations such as invalidating CloudFront caches and updating parameter values.
An infrastructure team needs idempotent, reviewable, declarative provisioning of VPCs, IAM roles, and RDS clusters through change sets instead of imperative scripts.

explanation: AWS RAM is the service for sharing supported resources such as Transit Gateways across accounts. The AWS Management Console is the right interface for ad hoc interactive inspection and one-off manual changes. The AWS CLI is appropriate when scripted, repeatable command execution is required. AWS CloudFormation is the declarative infrastructure-as-code service for versioned, reviewable, idempotent provisioning.
tags: Access controls and management across multiple accounts

stem: A bank is modernizing an order system built around JMS queues and topics on on-premises ActiveMQ brokers. The application code cannot be rewritten this quarter, but the company wants a managed highly available broker on AWS and a design that continues to decouple the web tier from worker throughput spikes. Which TWO design choices BEST satisfy these constraints? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Use Amazon MQ for ActiveMQ with a managed highly available broker deployment so existing JMS clients can reconnect with minimal code changes.
answers.B: Replace the broker with Amazon SQS FIFO queues and rewrite all JMS producers and consumers to the native SQS APIs immediately.
answers.C: Expose the broker behind an Application Load Balancer so messages can be distributed to consumers based on URL path rules.
answers.D: Keep the asynchronous message-broker pattern between the web tier and worker tier so the producer rate can be buffered independently of consumer processing speed.
answers.E: Replace the messaging layer with AWS AppSync subscriptions because they are a drop-in replacement for JMS durable topics.

explanation: Amazon MQ for ActiveMQ is the managed AWS service designed for organizations that need to preserve JMS-compatible broker semantics with minimal code changes. Retaining an asynchronous broker between producers and consumers is the architectural step that protects the web tier from worker backlogs and lets each tier scale independently. SQS could be a future redesign target, but it is not a minimal-change drop-in for existing JMS code. ALB and AppSync subscriptions do not replace broker semantics for this scenario.
tags: Queuing and messaging concepts (for example, publish/subscribe)

stem: A data platform team has two separate requirements: acquire a licensed third-party demographics dataset with automatic refreshes into AWS, and move incremental Salesforce lead changes into Amazon S3 every hour without maintaining custom code. Which TWO services BEST satisfy these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: AWS Data Exchange
answers.B: Amazon AppFlow
answers.C: Amazon MQ
answers.D: AWS Glue jobs written in Scala and maintained by the team
answers.E: AWS AppSync

explanation: AWS Data Exchange is the service for subscribing to third-party data products with managed entitlements and dataset revisions. Amazon AppFlow is the fully managed SaaS integration service for moving Salesforce data to S3 on a schedule without custom code. Amazon MQ is a managed message broker, Glue would add operational overhead that the requirement explicitly wants to avoid, and AppSync is a GraphQL API service rather than a SaaS-to-S3 data movement tool.
tags: Data transfer services with appropriate use cases (for example, AWS DataSync, AWS Storage Gateway)

stem: A product team is building mobile and web clients that require a managed GraphQL API with offline sync and conflict resolution. The frontend itself should be hosted with Git-based CI/CD, preview deployments, and a low-ops path to connect to backend services. Which TWO services should the team use? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: AWS AppSync
answers.B: AWS Amplify
answers.C: Amazon API Gateway with custom polling logic
answers.D: Amazon AppFlow
answers.E: AWS Elastic Beanstalk

explanation: AWS AppSync is the managed GraphQL service that supports offline sync and conflict resolution patterns for distributed clients. AWS Amplify provides frontend hosting, branch previews, CI/CD, and client integration libraries. API Gateway with custom polling would require more custom logic, AppFlow is for SaaS data integration, and Elastic Beanstalk is an application platform rather than a frontend delivery and GraphQL client workflow.
tags: Designing event-driven, microservice, and/or multi-tier architectures based on requirements

stem: A solutions architect is matching workloads to the most appropriate AWS deployment or migration service. Match each requirement to the BEST-FIT service. Each service is used once.

answers.A: AWS Outposts
answers.B: VMware Cloud on AWS
answers.C: AWS Wavelength
answers.D: AWS Application Migration Service

subquestions.prompt: A regulated manufacturing line must keep compute and storage inside the factory while still using AWS APIs and AWS-managed hardware on premises.
An enterprise wants the fastest way to move its vSphere estate into AWS while retaining VMware operational tooling and avoiding guest-level refactoring.
A 5G mobile application needs compute placed in the carrier network to minimize latency for users moving across a metropolitan area.
A company must replicate large numbers of physical and virtual servers at the block level into AWS and perform non-disruptive test cutovers before moving production traffic to EC2.

explanation: AWS Outposts is the on-premises AWS deployment model for workloads that must remain local but still use AWS APIs. VMware Cloud on AWS is the VMware-native landing zone in AWS for rapid vSphere extension and migration. AWS Wavelength places compute at the telecom edge for ultra-low-latency mobile workloads. AWS Application Migration Service is the lift-and-shift migration service for physical and virtual servers moving into EC2 with minimal change.
tags: Determining the appropriate placement of resources to meet business requirements

stem: A platform engineering team is choosing the right service for running or packaging workloads across customer-managed environments. Match each requirement to the MOST appropriate AWS service. Each service is used once.

answers.A: Amazon ECS Anywhere
answers.B: Amazon EKS Anywhere
answers.C: Amazon EKS Distro
answers.D: AWS Serverless Application Repository

subquestions.prompt: The operations team wants existing Linux hosts in branch offices to register as external instances and run centrally scheduled ECS tasks.
A retailer wants a supported Kubernetes experience on its own hardware, including installation and lifecycle management aligned to Amazon EKS tooling.
A defense contractor needs the same Kubernetes distribution and add-ons used by EKS so it can operate fully self-managed clusters in isolated environments.
A central cloud team wants to publish versioned, prepackaged serverless applications that other teams can discover and deploy directly as reusable building blocks.

explanation: Amazon ECS Anywhere extends the ECS control plane to customer-managed external instances. Amazon EKS Anywhere provides the supported cluster deployment and lifecycle experience for running Kubernetes on customer infrastructure. Amazon EKS Distro is the self-managed distribution of the Kubernetes components and add-ons used by EKS. AWS Serverless Application Repository is the reusable packaging and publishing layer for serverless applications.

stem: An insurer records all contact-center conversations. The business wants accurate transcripts with speaker attribution and then wants sentiment and entity analysis on those transcripts, all with minimal custom ML development. Which TWO services BEST meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Amazon Transcribe
answers.B: Amazon Comprehend
answers.C: Amazon Kendra
answers.D: Amazon Polly
answers.E: Amazon Rekognition

explanation: Amazon Transcribe converts audio to text and supports features such as speaker separation and custom vocabulary. Amazon Comprehend performs NLP analysis such as sentiment and entity extraction on the resulting text. Kendra is an enterprise search service, Polly is text-to-speech, and Rekognition is for visual analysis rather than speech analytics.
tags: Using purpose-built AWS services for workloads

stem: A warehouse operator wants a voice-enabled internal help kiosk. Employees should ask natural-language questions over a large document corpus and hear the returned answer spoken aloud. Which TWO AWS services BEST fit this design? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Amazon Kendra
answers.B: Amazon Polly
answers.C: Amazon Comprehend
answers.D: Amazon AppSync
answers.E: Amazon MQ

explanation: Amazon Kendra is the managed enterprise search service for natural-language questions over document repositories with ranked results and answer passages. Amazon Polly is the text-to-speech service that can vocalize the returned answer. Comprehend analyzes text rather than serving as a search engine or speech synthesizer, and AppSync and Amazon MQ are unrelated to this requirement.
tags: Using purpose-built AWS services for workloads

stem: A retailer wants near-real-time analytics on live camera feeds from stores. The architecture must ingest the video streams durably and run managed object and person detection on those feeds with as little custom media infrastructure as possible. Which TWO services BEST meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Amazon Kinesis Video Streams
answers.B: Amazon Rekognition
answers.C: Amazon Elastic Transcoder
answers.D: Amazon AppFlow
answers.E: Amazon Transcribe

explanation: Amazon Kinesis Video Streams is the ingestion and storage service for live video streams. Amazon Rekognition provides managed image and video analysis capabilities, including object and person detection. Elastic Transcoder is for converting stored video files, AppFlow is for SaaS integration, and Transcribe is for speech-to-text rather than computer vision.
tags: Using purpose-built AWS services for workloads

stem: A cloud governance office is choosing the right AWS service for each governance, audit, or review activity. Match each requirement to the MOST appropriate service. Each service is used once.

answers.A: AWS Control Tower
answers.B: AWS Service Catalog
answers.C: AWS Audit Manager
answers.D: AWS Health Dashboard
answers.E: AWS Well-Architected Tool

subquestions.prompt: An enterprise is onboarding acquired business units and needs a landing zone with centralized guardrails and account setup baselines.
Application teams must self-service provision only approved platform products such as standard VPC stacks and container platforms, using versions and parameters controlled by the central team.
Auditors want continuously collected evidence that maps operational data to compliance controls without manual screenshot gathering.
Operations needs to know whether a current AWS service event is affecting specific resources that belong to the company's accounts.
A solutions architect wants to run a structured review of a workload against AWS best-practice pillars and track remediation milestones afterward.

explanation: AWS Control Tower establishes a governed landing zone for multi-account environments. AWS Service Catalog is the curated self-service layer for approved products. AWS Audit Manager automates evidence collection for compliance assessments. AWS Health Dashboard provides account-specific health events. The AWS Well-Architected Tool supports formal workload reviews against AWS architectural best practices.

stem: A central security team must continuously scan EC2 instances, ECR images, and Lambda packages for vulnerabilities and then review all prioritized findings from multiple AWS security services in one place across accounts. Which TWO services BEST satisfy these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Amazon Inspector
answers.B: AWS Security Hub
answers.C: Amazon Detective
answers.D: AWS Audit Manager
answers.E: AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager

explanation: Amazon Inspector performs the continuous vulnerability assessments for supported compute and container artifacts. AWS Security Hub aggregates and normalizes findings across AWS security services and accounts. Detective is an investigation tool rather than the scanning or aggregation layer, Audit Manager is for compliance evidence, and Patch Manager handles patch orchestration rather than multi-service finding aggregation.
tags: Aligning AWS technologies to meet compliance requirements

stem: An analyst receives high-severity GuardDuty and Inspector findings from several accounts. The team needs one place to triage the findings and then a graph-based tool to pivot through related IPs, roles, API activity, and resources during investigation. Which TWO services should the architect use? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: AWS Security Hub
answers.B: Amazon Detective
answers.C: AWS CloudHSM
answers.D: AWS Health Dashboard
answers.E: AWS Control Tower

explanation: AWS Security Hub is the central triage layer for normalized findings from services such as GuardDuty and Inspector. Amazon Detective is the investigation service that builds relationship graphs across principals, API calls, IPs, and resources. CloudHSM, Health Dashboard, and Control Tower do not provide this paired triage-and-investigation capability.

stem: A platform team is selecting the correct AWS service for four cost, licensing, and observability requirements. Match each requirement to the MOST appropriate service. Each service is used once.

answers.A: AWS Cost and Usage Report
answers.B: Amazon Managed Grafana
answers.C: Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus
answers.D: AWS License Manager

subquestions.prompt: A FinOps team needs line-item AWS billing data, usage records, and amortized commitment information exported to S3 for Athena-based showback reporting.
Platform engineers need a managed dashboarding layer that can visualize CloudWatch, Prometheus, and X-Ray data sources without operating their own Grafana servers.
An EKS estate needs a managed PromQL-compatible backend for metrics scraped from Kubernetes workloads and queried by multiple teams.
A company must track software entitlements across EC2 and on-premises hosts to ensure it does not exceed purchased core-based licenses.

explanation: AWS Cost and Usage Report is the detailed billing export for advanced cost analysis. Amazon Managed Grafana is the managed visualization layer for multiple observability data sources. Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus is the managed metrics store and query engine for PromQL workloads. AWS License Manager tracks and governs software entitlements across hybrid estates.

stem: A central networking account owns a shared services VPC. Application accounts need to deploy into shared subnets, and remote administrators must reach those private resources from laptops without exposing bastion hosts to the internet. Which TWO AWS services BEST satisfy these needs? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM)
answers.B: AWS Client VPN
answers.C: Amazon AppFlow
answers.D: AWS Management Console
answers.E: AWS Transfer Family

explanation: AWS RAM is the service for sharing supported resources such as VPC subnets across accounts. AWS Client VPN provides secure remote user access from laptops into private VPC resources without publicly reachable bastions. The other options do not solve cross-account resource sharing or user-based remote network access.
tags: Access controls and management across multiple accounts

stem: A solutions architect is selecting the correct AWS database service for each workload pattern. Match each workload to the MOST appropriate service. Each service is used once.

answers.A: Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra)
answers.B: Amazon Neptune
answers.C: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility)
answers.D: Amazon Aurora
answers.E: Amazon DynamoDB

subquestions.prompt: A telemetry platform uses Cassandra drivers and wide-column schemas and wants a serverless AWS target without changing its CQL-based application logic.
A recommendation engine needs fast traversals across product, user, and interaction relationships using graph query patterns rather than joins.
A content management system stores evolving JSON documents and depends on MongoDB-compatible drivers and aggregation semantics.
A financial reporting application needs a managed relational database with ACID transactions, SQL joins, and read replicas using a familiar MySQL or PostgreSQL engine model.
A session store requires single-digit millisecond latency at scale, automatic key expiration, and no server management.

explanation: Amazon Keyspaces is the Cassandra-compatible managed service. Amazon Neptune is the graph database for highly connected traversal-heavy workloads. Amazon DocumentDB provides MongoDB compatibility for document-oriented applications. Amazon Aurora serves relational transactional workloads with SQL features and engine compatibility. Amazon DynamoDB is the serverless key-value and document database for low-latency at scale.
tags: Database types and services (for example, relational compared with non-relational, Amazon Aurora, Amazon DynamoDB)

stem: A solutions architect is selecting the most appropriate AWS migration or transfer service for each scenario. Match each scenario to the BEST-FIT service. Each service is used once.

answers.A: AWS Application Migration Service
answers.B: AWS DataSync
answers.C: AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)
answers.D: AWS Snow Family (Snowball Edge)
answers.E: AWS Transfer Family

subquestions.prompt: A company wants to lift and shift hundreds of physical and virtual application servers into EC2 with block-level replication, test cutovers, and minimal application changes.
An analytics team needs a scheduled, incremental, checksum-verified transfer from on-premises NFS shares into Amazon EFS.
A production Oracle database must be migrated to Aurora PostgreSQL with ongoing change data capture to minimize cutover downtime.
A media archive contains multiple petabytes of NAS data, and the available WAN bandwidth is too low to complete the migration within the required timeline.
External partners must continue using SFTP clients to send files into the company's AWS environment without retooling their client software.

explanation: AWS Application Migration Service is for minimal-change server migrations into EC2. AWS DataSync is for scheduled, incremental file transfers into AWS storage. AWS DMS handles database migrations and change data capture. Snowball Edge is the offline transfer mechanism when network transfer is impractical at petabyte scale. AWS Transfer Family provides managed SFTP, FTPS, and FTP endpoints backed by AWS storage services.
tags: Selecting the appropriate service for data migration to storage services

stem: A payment processor operates a custom TLS termination service on EC2 because regulatory requirements mandate that private keys remain inside customer-controlled FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSMs. The processor still needs a highly available load balancer in front of the fleet, but TLS must terminate on the application instances, not on the load balancer. Which TWO AWS services or features BEST meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: AWS CloudHSM
answers.B: Network Load Balancer with TCP listeners so TLS can terminate on the instances
answers.C: Application Load Balancer with ACM public certificates
answers.D: AWS KMS customer managed keys
answers.E: Gateway Load Balancer

explanation: AWS CloudHSM provides customer-controlled FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSMs for private key generation and use. A Network Load Balancer operating at Layer 4 can pass TCP connections through so TLS terminates on the instances that use those HSM-backed keys. An ALB would terminate TLS itself, KMS is not a drop-in HSM for custom TLS stacks, and GWLB is for inline network appliances rather than application traffic distribution.
tags: Encrypting data in transit (for example, AWS Certificate Manager [ACM] using TLS)
Load balancing concepts (for example, Application Load Balancer [ALB])

stem: A storage architect is selecting the most appropriate data movement or object management approach for each requirement. Match each requirement to the BEST-FIT strategy or service. Each answer is used once.

answers.A: AWS Storage Gateway - File Gateway
answers.B: Multipart Upload
answers.C: S3 Batch Operations
answers.D: AWS DataSync

subquestions.prompt: Legacy on-premises applications need an NFS or SMB file interface that transparently stores objects in Amazon S3 without changing the application code.
A browser-based application regularly uploads 50 GB design assets to Amazon S3 and needs resilient retries that resend only failed chunks.
An operations team must apply a new object tag or invoke a Lambda function across a massive existing S3 object set without custom inventory traversal.
A company needs scheduled, incremental migration of changing NAS data into Amazon EFS with integrity verification and bandwidth control.

explanation: File Gateway exposes S3-backed file shares to existing applications. Multipart Upload is the right large-object upload pattern when retries should occur at the part level. S3 Batch Operations performs large-scale actions across existing objects. AWS DataSync is the managed service for scheduled incremental file transfer with verification and throttling controls.
tags: Designing appropriate storage strategies (for example, batch uploads to Amazon S3 compared with individual uploads)
Selecting the appropriate service for data migration to storage services

stem: A solutions architect must pick the correct Elastic Load Balancing option for three network and application scenarios. Match each scenario to the MOST appropriate load balancer type. Each type is used once.

answers.A: Application Load Balancer (ALB)
answers.B: Network Load Balancer (NLB)
answers.C: Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB)

subquestions.prompt: A SaaS control plane needs cookie-based stickiness, WebSocket support, and user authentication integrated at the HTTP layer.
A private service must expose static IP addresses, preserve client source IP, and handle very high-scale TCP traffic with TLS termination left to the targets.
A security team needs to insert a fleet of virtual IDS and firewall appliances inline so traffic is steered through them transparently.

explanation: ALB is the Layer 7 load balancer for HTTP-aware features such as stickiness, WebSockets, and authentication. NLB is the Layer 4 option for very high-scale TCP traffic, static IPs, and source-IP preservation. GWLB is the transparent bump-in-the-wire option for fleets of third-party security appliances.
tags: Load balancing concepts (for example, Application Load Balancer [ALB])
Selecting the appropriate load balancing strategy

stem: A solutions architect is choosing the best Amazon EBS volume type for four workloads. Match each workload to the MOST appropriate volume type. Each type is used once.

answers.A: gp3 (General Purpose SSD)
answers.B: io2 Block Express
answers.C: st1 (Throughput Optimized HDD)
answers.D: sc1 (Cold HDD)

subquestions.prompt: A mission-critical transactional database requires extreme durability and consistently high provisioned IOPS with low latency.
Kubernetes worker nodes need cost-effective SSD root and data volumes with configurable IOPS and throughput independent of size.
A Hadoop and Spark estate performs mostly large sequential reads and writes, making throughput more important than high random IOPS.
An infrequently accessed compliance archive on block storage prioritizes the absolute lowest cost per GiB.

explanation: io2 Block Express is the premium high-performance EBS option for mission-critical databases. gp3 is the flexible SSD tier for general-purpose workloads that need decoupled size and performance. st1 is the throughput-focused HDD option for large sequential workloads. sc1 is the lowest-cost HDD option for cold, infrequently accessed block data.
tags: Block storage options (for example, hard disk drive [HDD] volume types, solid state drive [SSD] volume types)
Storage options and characteristics (for example, durability, replication)

stem: A principal architect is launching a quarterly cost-optimization program. The team needs detailed spend and usage evidence that can be queried at a granular level, and it also needs a structured AWS-native review workflow to record risks, best-practice gaps, and improvement plans. Which TWO services BEST meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: AWS Cost and Usage Report
answers.B: AWS Well-Architected Tool
answers.C: AWS Health Dashboard
answers.D: Amazon Managed Grafana
answers.E: AWS License Manager

explanation: AWS Cost and Usage Report is the detailed cost and usage dataset needed for granular financial analysis. The AWS Well-Architected Tool provides the structured review process for documenting risks, architectural gaps, and remediation plans over time. Health Dashboard, Managed Grafana, and License Manager solve adjacent operational problems but not this paired cost-evidence and architecture-review requirement.

stem: An operations team must stop an active outage caused by a misconfigured security group and then ensure the corrected rule set is preserved in future environments through versioned, reviewable infrastructure as code. Which TWO AWS interfaces or services BEST support those immediate and long-term needs? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: AWS Management Console for the immediate break-glass remediation
answers.B: AWS CloudFormation to codify the corrected steady state
answers.C: Repeated manual console changes in every environment after each release
answers.D: AWS Service Catalog without updating the underlying template
answers.E: Long-lived root credentials shared among administrators

explanation: The AWS Management Console is appropriate for an immediate interactive break-glass fix during an outage. AWS CloudFormation is the correct long-term mechanism to codify and version the corrected infrastructure state so future environments remain consistent. Repeating manual changes is not reliable, Service Catalog does not help unless the underlying infrastructure definition is updated, and shared root credentials violate AWS security best practices.
tags: Determining automation strategies to ensure infrastructure integrity

stem: A solutions architect is validating outbound connectivity and private AWS service access for a dual-stack VPC. Match each requirement to the AWS networking component that BEST satisfies it. Each component can be used once or more than once.

answers.A: Internet Gateway
answers.B: NAT Gateway
answers.C: Egress-only Internet Gateway
answers.D: Gateway VPC Endpoint

subquestions.prompt: Amazon EC2 instances in private IPv4 subnets must download patches from public package repositories without accepting unsolicited inbound internet connections.
Amazon EC2 instances in private IPv6 subnets must initiate outbound internet connections, but inbound sessions from the internet must remain blocked.
Workloads must reach Amazon S3 privately from the VPC without using NAT, internet routing, or per-hour interface endpoint charges.
An internet-facing Application Load Balancer in public subnets must be reachable by clients on the public internet over the VPC's public routing path.

explanation: A NAT gateway lets private IPv4 subnets initiate outbound internet connections while remaining unreachable from unsolicited inbound traffic. An egress-only internet gateway serves the same purpose for IPv6. A gateway VPC endpoint provides private route-table-based access to Amazon S3 without NAT charges or internet routing. An internet gateway is the VPC component that enables public subnets and internet-facing resources, such as a public ALB, to exchange traffic with the public internet.
tags: Designing VPC architectures with security components (for example, security groups, route tables, network ACLs, NAT gateways)
Determining network segmentation strategies (for example, using public subnets and private subnets)

stem: A company deploys third-party inspection appliances in a centralized security VPC. All east-west traffic between spoke VPCs must be steered through the appliances transparently, without changing application endpoints, and the appliances must scale horizontally. Which TWO design choices are REQUIRED? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Deploy a Gateway Load Balancer in the security VPC in front of the appliances.
answers.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the security VPC in front of the appliances.
answers.C: Create Gateway Load Balancer endpoints in the spoke VPCs and update subnet route tables to send inspected traffic to those endpoints.
answers.D: Create interface VPC endpoints in the spoke VPCs and point subnet routes to the endpoint ENIs.
answers.E: Replace routing with VPC peering between every spoke VPC and the security VPC.

explanation: Gateway Load Balancer is purpose-built for transparent insertion of third-party appliances by using the GENEVE protocol and preserving the original traffic flow semantics. Gateway Load Balancer endpoints are placed in the spoke VPCs so route tables can steer traffic to the inspection layer without changing application endpoints. ALBs and interface endpoints do not provide this transparent bump-in-the-wire behavior, and VPC peering alone cannot deliver managed traffic distribution and appliance scaling.
tags: Control ports, protocols, and network traffic on AWS
Load balancing concepts (for example, Application Load Balancer [ALB])

stem: A solutions architect is deciding how to connect workloads across AWS and on-premises environments. Match each requirement to the AWS connectivity option that BEST fits. Each option is used once.

answers.A: AWS Site-to-Site VPN
answers.B: AWS Direct Connect
answers.C: AWS PrivateLink
answers.D: VPC Peering

subquestions.prompt: A branch office needs an encrypted connection to AWS that can be provisioned quickly over its existing internet connection, even though throughput is lower and internet dependency remains.
A data center needs a dedicated private circuit into AWS for more consistent throughput and reduced internet jitter.
A service provider must expose a single TCP service privately to many customer VPCs, including customers with overlapping CIDR ranges, without granting broader network reachability.
Two VPCs with non-overlapping CIDR ranges need full bidirectional private IP connectivity, but no transitive routing or centralized hub is required.

explanation: Site-to-Site VPN is the quickest way to establish encrypted hybrid connectivity over the public internet. Direct Connect provides a dedicated private connection with more predictable performance. PrivateLink exposes specific services privately to consumer VPCs, even when CIDR ranges overlap, without exposing the rest of the provider network. VPC peering offers direct private IP reachability between two VPCs, but it does not support transitive routing.
tags: Securing external network connections to and from the AWS Cloud (for example, VPN, AWS Direct Connect)

stem: A company places Amazon CloudFront in front of an internet-facing Application Load Balancer that serves a public web application. The security team wants malicious requests such as SQL injection attempts blocked at the edge, and the origin must accept HTTPS traffic only from CloudFront rather than directly from arbitrary internet hosts. Which TWO actions BEST meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the CloudFront distribution and add rules that block SQL injection patterns.
answers.B: Restrict the ALB security group inbound source to the AWS-managed CloudFront origin-facing prefix list.
answers.C: Replace CloudFront with AWS Global Accelerator so the ALB is no longer publicly reachable.
answers.D: Add a network ACL to the ALB subnets listing all current CloudFront IP ranges manually and update it whenever ranges change.
answers.E: Enable AWS Shield Advanced on the ALB only; this will also block SQL injection patterns.

explanation: AWS WAF attached to CloudFront can block SQL injection and similar application-layer attacks at the edge before the requests reach the origin. Restricting the ALB security group to the AWS-managed CloudFront prefix list helps ensure the origin accepts traffic only from CloudFront origin-facing infrastructure. Global Accelerator does not replace edge caching or WAF behavior for this use case, manually curating CloudFront IPs in a NACL is operationally brittle, and Shield Advanced is for DDoS protection rather than SQL injection filtering.
tags: Integrating AWS services to secure applications (for example, AWS Shield, AWS WAF, IAM Identity Center, AWS Secrets Manager)
Threat vectors external to AWS (for example, DDoS, SQL injection)

stem: A solutions architect must choose the most appropriate AWS traffic-distribution service for each requirement. Match each requirement to the BEST-FIT service or load-balancing option. Each option is used once.

answers.A: Application Load Balancer
answers.B: Network Load Balancer
answers.C: Gateway Load Balancer
answers.D: Amazon Route 53

subquestions.prompt: HTTP and HTTPS microservices need host-based routing, path-based routing, and WebSocket support behind a single endpoint.
A latency-sensitive TCP service needs static IP addresses, very high connection rates, and client source IP preservation.
Third-party virtual appliances must inspect traffic transparently while scaling horizontally behind a managed distribution layer.
Traffic should be directed at the DNS layer to healthy regional endpoints rather than proxied through a load balancer.

explanation: ALB is the right choice for advanced Layer 7 routing features such as host-based and path-based routing. NLB is designed for high-performance Layer 4 traffic, static IPs, and source IP preservation. GWLB is purpose-built for transparent insertion of virtual appliances. Route 53 performs DNS-layer traffic steering to endpoints instead of proxying connections itself.
tags: Selecting the appropriate load balancing strategy
Load balancing concepts (for example, Application Load Balancer)

stem: A retailer is decomposing a monolithic application into microservices across multiple AWS accounts. One payments service must be consumed synchronously and privately from many consumer VPCs that use overlapping CIDR ranges. Separately, checkout requests must be buffered so frontend traffic spikes do not overwhelm downstream order processors. Which TWO design choices BEST satisfy these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Expose the payments service through a Network Load Balancer and publish it as an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service.
answers.B: Connect every consumer VPC to the payments VPC with VPC peering.
answers.C: Put Amazon SQS between the frontend and order-processing microservices.
answers.D: Use Amazon SNS only for order buffering so consumers can poll messages when ready.
answers.E: Use a shared AWS Transit Gateway for the payments service requirement because overlapping CIDR ranges are supported natively for attached VPCs.

explanation: PrivateLink is the correct pattern when a single service must be consumed privately by many VPCs, including VPCs with overlapping CIDR ranges, without exposing full network reachability. Amazon SQS provides durable buffering so the frontend and order processors can scale independently and absorb spikes. VPC peering and Transit Gateway require routable non-overlapping networks for general connectivity. SNS is pub/sub fanout, not queue-based load leveling for independently scaled workers.
tags: Determining the AWS services required to achieve loose coupling based on requirements
Queuing and messaging concepts (for example, publish/subscribe)

stem: A global application uses Amazon Route 53 to steer users among regional endpoints. Match each routing requirement to the Route 53 routing policy that BEST implements it. Each policy is used once.

answers.A: Failover
answers.B: Weighted
answers.C: Latency-based
answers.D: Geolocation

subquestions.prompt: A new regional endpoint must receive exactly 10% of production traffic while the existing endpoint continues to receive 90%, regardless of client location.
Users in Europe must be sent to eu-west-1 and users in Asia Pacific must be sent to ap-southeast-2 based on geographic origin rather than measured latency.
Users should normally reach the healthy Region with the lowest measured network latency from their DNS resolver location.
A secondary Region should receive traffic only when the primary endpoint becomes unhealthy.

explanation: Weighted routing is used for deliberate percentage-based traffic splitting such as canaries. Geolocation routing selects endpoints based on the user geographic location rather than latency. Latency-based routing selects the Region with the best measured network latency from the resolver. Failover routing supports active-passive architectures in which the secondary is used only when the primary fails health checks.
tags: AWS global infrastructure (for example, Availability Zones, AWS Regions, Amazon Route 53)

stem: A gaming company runs regional TCP matchmaking services. Players worldwide must connect through the nearest healthy AWS edge location, fail over quickly to another healthy Region without depending on DNS TTL expiry, and use a fixed pair of public IP addresses that can be allow-listed by enterprise customers. Which TWO services or design elements are REQUIRED? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: AWS Global Accelerator
answers.B: Amazon CloudFront
answers.C: Network Load Balancers deployed in each target Region
answers.D: Amazon Route 53 latency-based records only
answers.E: An internet gateway in each application VPC

explanation: AWS Global Accelerator provides static anycast IP addresses, directs traffic into the nearest healthy AWS edge location, and performs rapid failover without relying on client DNS cache behavior. Regional Network Load Balancers are appropriate endpoints for the TCP matchmaking services. CloudFront is optimized for HTTP/HTTPS content distribution, Route 53 alone still depends on DNS resolution behavior, and an internet gateway is necessary for internet access in a VPC but does not solve the stated global front-door requirements.
tags: Determining the AWS services required to provide a highly available and/or fault-tolerant architecture across AWS Regions or Availability Zones
Edge networking services with appropriate use cases (for example, Amazon CloudFront, AWS Global Accelerator)

stem: A solutions architect is choosing the right cross-Region networking approach for resiliency requirements. Match each requirement to the AWS service or feature that BEST satisfies it. Each option is used once.

answers.A: Route 53 failover routing
answers.B: AWS Global Accelerator
answers.C: Transit Gateway inter-Region peering
answers.D: Inter-Region VPC Peering

subquestions.prompt: Internet clients must continue using the same anycast IP addresses while traffic is redirected away from an unhealthy Region within seconds.
A public web application can tolerate DNS-based failover and should send traffic to a standby Application Load Balancer only when the primary ALB health check fails.
A hub-and-spoke architecture needs private, transitive connectivity between many VPCs in different Regions over the AWS backbone.
Exactly two VPCs in different Regions need private connectivity, and no transitive hub or third-VPC routing is required.

explanation: Global Accelerator is the right option when clients need fixed anycast IPs and rapid regional failover that does not depend on DNS cache expiry. Route 53 failover routing is appropriate for DNS-based active-passive failover. Transit Gateway inter-Region peering supports transitive hub-and-spoke connectivity across Regions on the AWS backbone. Inter-Region VPC peering provides direct connectivity between two VPCs but still does not support transitive routing.

stem: A company operates a public HTTPS API in two AWS Regions behind Application Load Balancers. Some enterprise clients cache DNS responses aggressively, so failover must not rely on clients honoring low Route 53 TTLs. The company also wants a single global entry point that automatically routes users to the optimal healthy Region. Which TWO actions BEST meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Create an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator with listeners for the API ports.
answers.B: Add each regional Application Load Balancer to a Global Accelerator endpoint group and rely on accelerator health checks.
answers.C: Replace the ALBs with CloudFront distributions because CloudFront always provides non-DNS failover for dynamic APIs.
answers.D: Use Route 53 multivalue answer routing with 0-second TTLs.
answers.E: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration in front of the ALBs.

explanation: Global Accelerator provides a single global front door with static anycast IPs and health-aware routing that does not depend on client DNS cache behavior. Registering the regional ALBs in endpoint groups lets Global Accelerator direct traffic to the best healthy Region automatically. Route 53 still depends on DNS lookups and client caching behavior, CloudFront is not a general substitute for this non-cacheable multi-Region API failover requirement, and S3 Transfer Acceleration is unrelated to ALB-based API entry points.
tags: Selecting the appropriate load balancing strategy

stem: A solutions architect is choosing AWS building blocks for different private connectivity topologies. Match each topology requirement to the AWS service or feature that BEST fits. Each option is used once.

answers.A: AWS Transit Gateway
answers.B: VPC Peering
answers.C: AWS PrivateLink
answers.D: AWS Direct Connect Gateway

subquestions.prompt: Hundreds of VPCs across accounts need transitive connectivity through a central hub with simplified route management.
Two VPCs with non-overlapping CIDR ranges need direct private IP reachability and the simplest possible data path.
A provider must expose one application privately to consumer VPCs that may have overlapping CIDR ranges, without exposing the rest of the provider VPC.
One private connection from on-premises must reach VPCs in multiple AWS Regions through associated AWS constructs.

explanation: Transit Gateway is the hub-and-spoke service for scalable transitive connectivity across many VPCs. VPC peering is the simplest direct option for point-to-point connectivity between two non-overlapping VPCs. PrivateLink exposes a specific service privately without general network adjacency and works with overlapping CIDRs. A Direct Connect Gateway allows a private Direct Connect connection to reach associated resources in multiple Regions.
tags: Creating a network topology for various architectures (for example, global, hybrid, multi-tier)
Determining network configurations that can scale to accommodate future needs

stem: An enterprise needs 20 Gbps of private connectivity from its data center into AWS. The design must aggregate bandwidth across multiple physical links, reduce the blast radius of a single port failure, and provide reachability from the data center to application VPCs in several AWS Regions. Which TWO design choices BEST meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Create a Link Aggregation Group (LAG) using multiple AWS Direct Connect dedicated connections.
answers.B: Use a single AWS Site-to-Site VPN with acceleration enabled.
answers.C: Expose each VPC through AWS PrivateLink endpoint services.
answers.D: Use an AWS Direct Connect Gateway associated with the required multi-Region attachments.
answers.E: Use VPC peering between all Regions and advertise those routes over the Direct Connect public virtual interface.

explanation: A Direct Connect Link Aggregation Group combines multiple dedicated connections to increase aggregate bandwidth and reduce dependence on any single physical port. A Direct Connect Gateway lets those private connections reach associated resources across multiple AWS Regions. Site-to-Site VPN does not meet the throughput or private-circuit requirement, PrivateLink exposes services rather than full private network reachability, and public virtual interfaces are not used to advertise private VPC routes.
tags: Determining network configurations that can scale to accommodate future needs
Selecting the appropriate bandwidth allocation for a network device (for example, a single VPN compared with multiple VPNs, Direct Connect speed)

stem: A company is designing hybrid DNS resolution between on-premises networks and Amazon VPCs. Match each requirement to the Route 53 or Resolver component that BEST satisfies it. Each option is used once.

answers.A: Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint
answers.B: Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoint
answers.C: Route 53 private hosted zone
answers.D: Route 53 public hosted zone

subquestions.prompt: On-premises DNS servers must resolve private names hosted inside a VPC, such as internal application records.
EC2 instances in a VPC must resolve names hosted on on-premises DNS servers by forwarding specific domains out of the VPC.
Internal records should resolve only for VPCs explicitly associated to the zone.
Internet users must resolve the company public domain to a CloudFront distribution.

explanation: Resolver inbound endpoints let on-premises resolvers forward DNS queries into AWS for private records. Resolver outbound endpoints let VPC workloads forward selected domain queries to on-premises DNS. Private hosted zones serve records only inside associated VPCs. Public hosted zones publish records to the internet DNS hierarchy for public name resolution.
tags: Creating a network topology for various architectures (for example, global, hybrid, multi-tier)
Network connection options (for example, AWS VPN, AWS Direct Connect, AWS PrivateLink)

stem: A company runs shared DNS appliances in a central networking account. Application VPCs in many AWS accounts need to resolve selected on-premises namespaces through those appliances, but the company wants to avoid full-mesh VPC peering and keep routing manageable as the environment grows. Which TWO design choices BEST fit these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Use AWS Transit Gateway as the hub for VPC attachments and centralized routing.
answers.B: Peer every application VPC directly with the shared-services VPC that hosts the DNS appliances.
answers.C: Publish the on-premises namespaces in a Route 53 public hosted zone.
answers.D: Create Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoints and forwarding rules in the networking account, then share the rules with application accounts by using AWS RAM.
answers.E: Create separate NAT gateways in each application VPC so DNS queries can exit to the internet and re-enter the data center.

explanation: Transit Gateway gives the environment a scalable hub-and-spoke topology instead of brittle full-mesh peering. Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoints and shared forwarding rules allow centralized hybrid DNS resolution to on-premises namespaces without self-managing DNS forwarding instances in each application VPC. Public hosted zones are not appropriate for private namespaces, and NAT gateways are unrelated to direct private hybrid DNS forwarding.
tags: Creating a network topology for various architectures (for example, global, hybrid, multi-tier)
Determining network configurations that can scale to accommodate future needs

stem: A solutions architect is optimizing ongoing network cost for several VPC designs. Match each scenario to the MOST cost-appropriate AWS networking option. Each option is used once.

answers.A: Gateway VPC Endpoint
answers.B: Interface VPC Endpoint
answers.C: Single shared NAT Gateway
answers.D: NAT Gateway in each Availability Zone

subquestions.prompt: A one-AZ development VPC occasionally needs outbound internet access for private instances, and the business explicitly accepts AZ-level egress failure to minimize hourly cost.
A production application runs in three AZs and sends significant outbound internet traffic from private subnets; the design must avoid cross-AZ data processing and preserve zonal resilience.
Private workloads need low-cost private access to Amazon S3 and DynamoDB without NAT data processing charges.
Private workloads must call AWS Secrets Manager privately from a VPC with no internet route; this service does not support gateway endpoints.

explanation: A single NAT gateway is the lowest-hourly-cost choice for a nonproduction one-AZ environment that accepts egress failure in an AZ outage. NAT gateways in each AZ are more cost-effective for resilient high-volume production designs because they avoid cross-AZ data charges and zonal dependencies. Gateway endpoints provide the lowest-cost private access to S3 and DynamoDB. Interface endpoints are required for private access to services such as Secrets Manager that do not support gateway endpoints.
tags: Configuring appropriate NAT gateway types for a network (for example, a single shared NAT gateway compared with NAT gateways for each Availability Zone)

Configuring appropriate network routes to minimize network transfer costs (for example, Region to Region, Availability Zone to Availability Zone, private to public, AWS Global Accelerator, VPC endpoints)

stem: A batch analytics platform runs in private subnets across two Availability Zones. Instances download large input datasets from Amazon S3 and write job metadata to DynamoDB. The instances also call a third-party HTTPS API, so NAT gateways are still required. NAT data-processing charges are much higher than expected. Which TWO changes will reduce cost MOST directly without sacrificing the current availability model? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3.
answers.B: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon DynamoDB.
answers.C: Replace both NAT gateways with a single NAT gateway in one AZ.
answers.D: Create interface VPC endpoints for Amazon S3 and DynamoDB instead of gateway endpoints.
answers.E: Move the third-party API behind AWS PrivateLink.

explanation: Gateway endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB remove a large share of AWS-bound traffic from the NAT gateways and avoid NAT data-processing charges while preserving the existing multi-AZ NAT design for the remaining third-party internet calls. Collapsing to one NAT gateway would reduce availability and can introduce cross-AZ data transfer, and interface endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB are not the most cost-effective endpoint types for these services.
tags: Configuring appropriate network routes to minimize network transfer costs (for example, Region to Region, Availability Zone to Availability Zone, private to public, AWS Global Accelerator, VPC endpoints)
NAT gateways (for example, NAT instance costs compared with NAT gateway costs)

stem: A solutions architect is evaluating network optimizations for different traffic patterns. Match each optimization goal to the AWS service or feature that BEST addresses it. Each option is used once.

answers.A: Amazon CloudFront
answers.B: AWS Global Accelerator
answers.C: Transit Gateway inter-Region peering
answers.D: VPC Endpoint

subquestions.prompt: Reduce repeated origin fetches and lower data transfer for cacheable HTTPS content consumed globally.
Improve availability and path selection for a globally distributed, non-cacheable TCP application that needs static anycast IP addresses.
Keep private traffic flowing between hub VPCs in different Regions over the AWS backbone instead of public internet or VPN overlays.
Allow workloads in a VPC to reach supported AWS services privately and avoid NAT processing charges.

explanation: CloudFront reduces origin load and internet data transfer for cacheable content by serving it from edge locations. Global Accelerator improves global entry-point availability and routing performance for non-cacheable TCP/UDP or HTTP applications that need static anycast IPs. Transit Gateway inter-Region peering keeps private inter-Region traffic on the AWS backbone between hubs. VPC endpoints provide private access to supported AWS services and can reduce NAT-related charges.
tags: Determining strategic needs for content delivery networks (CDNs) and edge caching

Configuring appropriate network routes to minimize network transfer costs (for example, Region to Region, Availability Zone to Availability Zone, private to public, AWS Global Accelerator, VPC endpoints)

stem: A company currently maintains dozens of point-to-point VPN connections from branch offices to multiple AWS VPCs. Traffic patterns are steady year-round, several branches regularly push more than 1 Gbps, and leadership wants to lower long-term per-GB networking cost while simplifying topology. Which TWO changes BEST align with these goals? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Use AWS Direct Connect for the high-throughput private connectivity.
answers.B: Continue with only AWS Site-to-Site VPN because internet-based tunnels are always cheaper at scale.
answers.C: Use an AWS Direct Connect Gateway so a smaller number of private connections can reach multiple VPCs across Regions.
answers.D: Replace all private connectivity with Amazon CloudFront.
answers.E: Use AWS PrivateLink for full branch-to-VPC network connectivity.

explanation: For steady high-throughput hybrid traffic, Direct Connect usually provides a better long-term cost and performance profile than maintaining many VPN tunnels over the internet. A Direct Connect Gateway simplifies topology by allowing a smaller set of private connections to reach multiple VPCs across Regions. VPN remains useful for backup or rapid deployment, but it is not the most cost-effective primary model at the stated scale. CloudFront and PrivateLink do not replace general branch-to-VPC connectivity.
tags: Configuring appropriate network connections (for example, AWS Direct Connect compared with VPN compared with internet)
Selecting the appropriate bandwidth allocation for a network device (for example, a single VPN compared with multiple VPNs, Direct Connect speed)

stem: A security architect is selecting the correct AWS network control for several traffic-filtering requirements. Match each requirement to the BEST-FIT control or component. Each option is used once.

answers.A: Security group referencing another security group
answers.B: Network ACL explicit deny rule
answers.C: Route table with no egress path to the destination
answers.D: AWS Network Firewall

subquestions.prompt: Only application instances that are members of a specific security group should reach the database on TCP 3306, even if instance IP addresses change frequently.
A subnet must block a known malicious CIDR range before more general allow rules are evaluated.
A private subnet must be prevented from reaching the internet simply by ensuring no default route exists to an internet or NAT target.
The organization needs centralized, stateful inspection with managed rule groups and domain-based filtering for traffic traversing a VPC.

explanation: Security groups can reference other security groups, making them ideal for dynamic instance-to-instance policy such as allowing only the application tier to reach the database tier. Network ACLs operate at the subnet boundary and can apply explicit deny rules in order. The absence of an egress route in a route table prevents traffic from leaving for that destination entirely. AWS Network Firewall provides centralized, stateful inspection and advanced rule processing beyond what security groups and NACLs offer.
tags: Designing VPC architectures with security components (for example, security groups, route tables, network ACLs, NAT gateways)
Control ports, protocols, and network traffic on AWS

stem: A hybrid environment must support bi-directional DNS resolution: on-premises users need to resolve private records hosted in AWS, and Amazon EC2 instances must resolve a subset of corporate domains hosted on-premises. The company wants to avoid self-managed DNS forwarders. Which TWO components are REQUIRED? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoints in the VPCs that host the private records
answers.B: Route 53 Resolver outbound endpoints plus forwarding rules for the on-premises domains
answers.C: A Route 53 public hosted zone for the internal domains
answers.D: NAT gateways so DNS queries can traverse to the internet first
answers.E: Amazon CloudFront distributions in front of the DNS servers

explanation: Resolver inbound endpoints are required when on-premises DNS systems must forward queries into AWS for private names. Resolver outbound endpoints with forwarding rules are required when VPC workloads must resolve selected domains hosted on on-premises DNS infrastructure. Public hosted zones are not suitable for private internal domains, and neither NAT gateways nor CloudFront provide managed hybrid DNS forwarding.
tags: Creating a network topology for various architectures (for example, global, hybrid, multi-tier)
Network connection options (for example, AWS VPN, AWS Direct Connect, AWS PrivateLink)

stem: A solutions architect must select the right API exposure pattern for several HTTP services. Match each requirement to the BEST-FIT Amazon API Gateway endpoint type or front-door option. Each option is used once.

answers.A: Edge-optimized API Gateway
answers.B: Regional API Gateway
answers.C: Private API Gateway
answers.D: Application Load Balancer

subquestions.prompt: A public API for a global mobile application should use the CloudFront distribution managed by API Gateway to improve edge access without the team building a separate CDN layer.

A public API will be fronted by a separately managed CloudFront or AWS WAF strategy, so the team wants the API endpoint to remain regional rather than using the API Gateway-managed global edge pattern.
An API must be reachable only from specific VPCs and from on-premises networks over private connectivity, with no public internet reachability.
A containerized web service needs host-based and path-based routing across multiple target groups rather than API Gateway features such as usage plans or authorizers.

explanation: Edge-optimized API Gateway uses a CloudFront distribution managed by API Gateway for global clients. Regional API Gateway keeps the endpoint regional, which is appropriate when the team wants to manage its own separate edge layer. Private API Gateway is the option for APIs that must stay private to VPC and hybrid callers through interface endpoints. An ALB is the better fit when the requirement is Layer 7 routing to target groups rather than managed API features.
tags: API creation and management (for example, Amazon API Gateway, REST API)
Selecting the appropriate load balancing strategy

stem: A healthcare company already has private hybrid connectivity from its data center into an Amazon VPC. It must expose a REST API to workloads in that VPC and to on-premises callers, but the API must never be publicly reachable from the internet. The team wants to minimize self-managed proxy infrastructure and retain API Gateway features such as authorizers and throttling. Which TWO design choices BEST meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Create an API Gateway private API.
answers.B: Create interface VPC endpoints for execute-api in the VPC and enable private DNS for VPC callers.
answers.C: Put an internet-facing Application Load Balancer in public subnets and allow only the data center CIDR ranges.
answers.D: Publish the API through Amazon CloudFront with signed URLs.
answers.E: Use an edge-optimized API Gateway custom domain.

explanation: A private API Gateway endpoint keeps the API off the public internet while preserving API Gateway features such as throttling and authorizers. Interface VPC endpoints for execute-api provide the private network path for VPC callers and can also be reached from on-premises over existing private hybrid connectivity. The public ALB and edge-optimized API choices violate the requirement that the API never be publicly reachable.
tags: API creation and management (for example, Amazon API Gateway, REST API)

stem: A solutions architect is configuring AWS Direct Connect for several distinct traffic patterns. Match each requirement to the Direct Connect interface or connectivity option that BEST fits. Each option is used once.

answers.A: Private virtual interface
answers.B: Public virtual interface
answers.C: Transit virtual interface
answers.D: AWS Site-to-Site VPN

subquestions.prompt: A private circuit must reach a single VPC through a virtual private gateway by using private IP space over the Direct Connect connection.
The data center must reach AWS public services such as Amazon S3 over the Direct Connect connection by using AWS public IP addresses.
A single Direct Connect connection must reach many VPCs through a Transit Gateway routing domain.
An encrypted internet-based backup path is needed if the dedicated circuit becomes unavailable.

explanation: A private virtual interface is used for private connectivity to a VPC through a virtual private gateway. A public virtual interface reaches AWS public services such as S3 over the Direct Connect circuit. A transit virtual interface is used with Direct Connect Gateway and Transit Gateway designs to reach many VPCs through a transit routing domain. Site-to-Site VPN is the internet-based encrypted backup path.
tags: Configuring appropriate network connections (for example, AWS Direct Connect compared with VPN compared with internet)
Determining network configurations that can scale to accommodate future needs

stem: A media company has a 10 Gbps Direct Connect connection from its data center to AWS. The data center must upload content to an Amazon S3 bucket and also reach application VPCs privately over the same physical circuit. The company wants the correct routing model on that existing connection rather than adding more circuits. Which TWO networking configurations are REQUIRED? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Create a public virtual interface for Amazon S3 and other AWS public service endpoints.
answers.B: Create a private virtual interface or a transit virtual interface for VPC connectivity, depending on whether the design uses a VGW or Transit Gateway.
answers.C: Use only a private virtual interface because Amazon S3 is inside a VPC.
answers.D: Expose Amazon S3 through AWS PrivateLink from the data center.
answers.E: Use VPC peering from the data center router to the VPCs.

explanation: Amazon S3 is accessed over a Direct Connect public virtual interface because S3 is an AWS public service, even though traffic stays on the AWS network after entering Direct Connect. Private VPC connectivity requires a private virtual interface or a transit virtual interface, depending on whether the target is a virtual private gateway or a Transit Gateway design. S3 is not reached through a private VIF alone, and PrivateLink or VPC peering do not solve the on-premises routing requirement.
tags: Configuring appropriate network connections (for example, AWS Direct Connect compared with VPN compared with internet)

Configuring appropriate network routes to minimize network transfer costs (for example, Region to Region, Availability Zone to Availability Zone, private to public, AWS Global Accelerator, VPC endpoints)

stem: An enterprise wants a more resilient hybrid network. The primary path from on-premises to AWS should be a dedicated private connection, but encrypted connectivity should still exist if that circuit fails. Dynamic routes should fail over automatically without manual route edits. Which TWO design choices BEST meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Use AWS Direct Connect as the primary path.
answers.B: Add AWS Site-to-Site VPN terminating on the same virtual private gateway or Transit Gateway.
answers.C: Use Amazon CloudFront as the failover transport for the hybrid private addresses.
answers.D: Use static routes only on both connections because BGP cannot be used with AWS-managed connectivity.
answers.E: Remove VPN and depend on a second NAT gateway in the VPC.

explanation: A common resilient hybrid pattern is to use Direct Connect as the preferred primary path and Site-to-Site VPN as the encrypted backup path. With BGP, AWS can prefer the Direct Connect path and fail to VPN automatically if the dedicated circuit becomes unavailable. CloudFront and NAT gateways are not hybrid network failover mechanisms, and static routes remove the dynamic failover benefit.
tags: Configuring appropriate network connections (for example, AWS Direct Connect compared with VPN compared with internet)

stem: A solutions architect is selecting the correct VPC endpoint or egress pattern for private workloads. Match each requirement to the BEST-FIT option. Each option is used once.

answers.A: Gateway VPC Endpoint
answers.B: Interface VPC Endpoint
answers.C: Gateway Load Balancer Endpoint
answers.D: NAT Gateway

subquestions.prompt: Private instances need low-cost private access to Amazon S3 by using route table entries instead of ENI-based endpoints.
Private instances need ENI-based private connectivity to AWS Secrets Manager with optional private DNS for the standard service hostname.
Subnet route tables must steer traffic to centralized third-party inspection appliances deployed behind a Gateway Load Balancer.
Private workloads must reach a public third-party HTTPS API that does not provide any PrivateLink-style connectivity.

explanation: Gateway endpoints are the route-table-based option for low-cost private access to S3 and DynamoDB. Interface endpoints provide ENI-based private connectivity and private DNS for many AWS services such as Secrets Manager. Gateway Load Balancer endpoints are used when route tables must steer traffic through centralized inspection appliances. A NAT gateway remains the standard pattern when private IPv4 workloads need outbound access to public third-party services.

stem: A private container platform runs entirely in private subnets with no internet gateway or NAT. Worker nodes must pull container images from Amazon ECR and download layer artifacts from Amazon S3. Which TWO networking changes are REQUIRED for the nodes to operate without internet access? (Select TWO.)

answers.A: Create interface VPC endpoints for Amazon ECR API and Amazon ECR DKR.
answers.B: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3.
answers.C: Create only an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon S3.
answers.D: Add an egress-only internet gateway for IPv4 traffic.
answers.E: Add an internet-facing Network Load Balancer in the cluster VPC.

explanation: ECR image pulls require private connectivity to the ECR API and ECR DKR endpoints, which are provided through interface endpoints. The actual image layer data is stored in S3, so the private subnets also need a gateway endpoint for S3. An egress-only internet gateway is for IPv6 outbound internet traffic, not private AWS service access for IPv4 workloads.
tags: Determining appropriate placement of resources to meet business requirements
